text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: If I got to say the only thing that me and Rashad had a disagreement on was that. You are a troller who don't like to be trolled back. And then when you getting trolled back and we don't have your back, which you not giving us the play.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas explains his lack of awareness during the McCants controversy
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know what was going on because I'm dealing with my own shit going on.
quotes.quote: The problem with that was I didn't know what was going on because I'm dealing with my own shit going on, so I'm not really in tune with the internet. So I didn't see y'all was having a little back and forth yet. So if you actually look at the episode, you can see he was trolling me the whole time. He was on troll mode. Everything I said, he goes the opposite the whole day. So when he sit there and threw that at me, I did exactly what he was doing to me, just go the opposite.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas details the behind-the-scenes drama with Rashad McCants
quotes.excerpt: I made him quit in the workout.
quotes.quote: I did Pat's show, and if you watch Pat's show, before we got into anything, Pat was like, 'Hey, I want to address some shit.' So he plays the clip, and he says, 'So this is what you got going on?' I said, 'This is all we seen, so we going off of this.' So then he plays the whole clip, and then he says, 'I don't know why McCants is talking. I made him quit in the workout.' I'm like, okay, okay. And then BJ did that. So soon as I got off it, I was like, 'Hey man, Pat was talking reckless, bro. Pat said this and this.' And then you know they them, 'Oh, that nigga, I'll cook that nigga.' I'm just so from there he was just throwing shots at Pat.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas explains the scheduling conflicts with Rashad McCants
quotes.excerpt: Pat's schedule and then Pat didn't come on, he gets to go.
quotes.quote: It's this: you know when your boy be like, 'Yeah, no, I'm going to whoop on dude.' I'm like, 'Yeah, you need our help?' 'No, no, it's about to be easy work.' So we just staying, we're staying in the car. And then we are there watching you getting your ass whooped. Like, you want us to come? No, I got this. We could have snuck around, tried to get a couple sneaks in. No, you just want to go out there. Bet. So all we all we we had to call just watching you getting your ass whooped. We didn't want to watch, we we wanted to help. I can throw a punch here, try to, you know, you know, throw some flower in a nigga eye, whatever you need from us, we can we can help. But you said you got this, you going to do this. Bet. Say less. I ain't feel like in sweaty in any goddamn way.
